title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Cherry Cranberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Cherry Cranberry combines three fruit favourites for a vibrant, layered vape. Sweet Strawberry leads the mix, followed by rich Cherry and a tart Cranberry note that adds balance and character. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod contains a 2ml prefilled pod attached to a 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil changes needed—just fit it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coils ensure consistent flavour and vapour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
